name: Theeb Rent A Car
verdict: Theeb Rent A Car Company is a listed Saudi company (Tadawul 4261); after its 2021 IPO the largest shareholders were the founding Al-Theeb family members, 23% each, with no state stake documented. Nothing found.
note: Car-rental company; Al-Shabab shirt sponsor in 2024-25 and 2025-26 - Theeb announced it had taken the upper chest of the team's shirts for the 2024-25 and 2025-26 seasons (Theeb Rent a Car LinkedIn post, September 2024, https://ae.linkedin.com/posts/theebrentacar_), and its triangle 'ذيّب Theeb' mark sits centre-chest on the 2025/26 home shirt sold in the club's official Offside store. NOT on the 2026-27 kit record: no 2026-27 placement evidence was found (the deal covered two seasons, to 2025-26), so theeb was removed from the al-shabab-2026-27-home kit in this PR. No human-rights finding against the company was found.
